description: This file defines a set of classes and functions for generating locators in different programming languages (JavaScript, Python, Java, C#) for use with Playwright testing framework. It includes utilities for parsing selectors, creating locator strings, and handling various locator options and types.

classes.name: LocatorFactory
classes.description: Interface defining methods for generating locator strings and chaining locators.

classes.name: JavaScriptLocatorFactory
classes.description: Implements LocatorFactory for JavaScript, generating locator strings compatible with Playwright JS API.

classes.name: PythonLocatorFactory
classes.description: Implements LocatorFactory for Python, generating locator strings compatible with Playwright Python API.

classes.name: JavaLocatorFactory
classes.description: Implements LocatorFactory for Java, generating locator strings compatible with Playwright Java API.

classes.name: CSharpLocatorFactory
classes.description: Implements LocatorFactory for C#, generating locator strings compatible with Playwright C# API.

classes.name: JsonlLocatorFactory
classes.description: Implements LocatorFactory for JSONL format, serializing locator data as JSON objects.

methods.name: asLocatorDescription
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of a selector based on its parsed structure.

methods.name: locatorCustomDescription
methods.description: Extracts custom description from a selector if available.

methods.name: asLocator
methods.description: Converts a selector string into a locator string for a specified language.

methods.name: asLocators
methods.description: Generates multiple locator strings from a selector, supporting complex selector parsing.

methods.name: detectExact
methods.description: Detects if a string indicates an exact match and returns the match type and text.

methods.name: isRegExp
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a RegExp.
